channel.title: Pier & Point · PG&E Southern Switchyard (outside the project boundary; not part of redevelopment)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for PG&E Southern Switchyard (outside the project boundary; not part of redevelopment) (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · PG&E Southern Switchyard (outside the project boundary; not part of redevelopment): The Design for Development shows two PG&E switchyards: a 4.8-acre Northern Switchyard at 22nd and Illinois inside the project boundary (covered on this map by Blocks 13 and 14), and a Southern Switchyard outside it. The shape on this record is the Southern one, so the record now says so: the 4.8-acre area and the 22nd and Illinois location were moved to the Northern Switchyard, the claim that it is outside the redevelopment site is limited to the Southern one, and the earlier comparison of the shape's area to 4.8 acres was withdrawn as coincidental. The shape itself was not changed. The dead 2019 draft link was replaced with the final February 2020 document, the label location was corrected to east of Illinois Street, and the land-use figure is tagged as a document rather than a rendering.
